flows:
Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/signin?demo=1 then Click the "Sign in" button
Go to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/app/shield
Type "AdaK9zXw2LmQ8rTvB3nYc7HsP4kJe6FgD1oWu5Ra2Fx" into the "Paste a Solana, Ethereum or Base address" field
Click "Check address"
Assert the result says "Blocked"
Assert the result says it looks like Ada’s saved address but isn’t

summary:
Opened the sign-in flow, then navigated to the Shield address-checking page.
Entered the provided wallet address and selected “Check address.”
The address was marked “Blocked,” with a warning that it looks like Ada’s saved address but is not.
The check was completed on the Shield page.
